summary: Central Puerto S.A. filed a Form 6-K (Argentine equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) disclosing the automatic cancellation of 2,299,993 treasury shares acquired between September 8 and October 11, 2023 under its August 24, 2023 buyback plan. Under Article 67 of Argentina's Capital Markets Law No. 26,831, shares held three years without shareholder resolution on their destination cancel by operation of law. Share capital falls to ARS 1,511,470,229 across 1,511,470,229 one-vote common shares at ARS 1 par; the board will register the reduction. A modest, mechanical capital reduction, not a special situation.
